proof_spine: Name the image f(K) once and pull an arbitrary open cover back along f.
Use compactness of K to obtain a finite pullback subcover.
Push the same finite indices forward to cover the named image.

blocks.intent: Use image_of_K as the canonical local spelling of the repeated image set.

thm continuous_image_of_compact_is_compact:
    ? forall [ContinuousMapSetting], K power_set(X):
        $is_compact_subset(X, open_sets_X, K)
        =>:
            $is_compact_subset(Y, open_sets_Y, fn_range(fn(x K) Y {f(x)}))
    have image_of_K power_set(Y) = fn_range(fn(x K) Y {f(x)})
    claim:
        ? forall Index set, cover fn(index Index) open_sets_Y:
            image_of_K $subset family_union(fn_range(cover))
            =>:
                exist J power_set(Index) st {$is_finite_set(J), image_of_K $subset family_union(fn_range(fn(index J) open_sets_Y {cover(index)}))}
        have fn pullback_cover(index Index) open_sets_X = {x X: f(x) $in cover(index)}
        claim:
            ? K $subset family_union(fn_range(pullback_cover))
            claim:
                ? forall point K:
                    point $in family_union(fn_range(pullback_cover))
                fn(x K) Y {f(x)}(point) $in image_of_K
                fn(x K) Y {f(x)}(point) = f(point)
                f(point) $in image_of_K
                f(point) $in family_union(fn_range(cover))
                obtain target_open from exist target_open fn_range(cover) st {f(point) $in target_open}
                have by preimage selected_index from target_open $in fn_range(cover)
                target_open = cover(selected_index)
                f(point) $in cover(selected_index)
                by thm set_builder_member(point, {x X: f(x) $in cover(selected_index)}) => point $in {x X: f(x) $in cover(selected_index)}
                point $in pullback_cover(selected_index)
                pullback_cover(selected_index) $in fn_range(pullback_cover)
                point $in family_union(fn_range(pullback_cover))
            by def:
                ? K $subset family_union(fn_range(pullback_cover))
        exist J power_set(Index) st {$is_finite_set(J), K $subset family_union(fn_range(fn(index J) open_sets_X {pullback_cover(index)}))}
        obtain J from exist J power_set(Index) st {$is_finite_set(J), K $subset family_union(fn_range(fn(index J) open_sets_X {pullback_cover(index)}))}
        witness exist finite_indices power_set(Index) st {$is_finite_set(finite_indices), image_of_K $subset family_union(fn_range(fn(index finite_indices) open_sets_Y {cover(index)}))} from J:
            $is_finite_set(J)
            claim:
                ? image_of_K $subset family_union(fn_range(fn(index J) open_sets_Y {cover(index)}))
                claim:
                    ? forall image_point image_of_K:
                        image_point $in family_union(fn_range(fn(index J) open_sets_Y {cover(index)}))
                    have by preimage source_point from image_point $in image_of_K
                    source_point $in K
                    image_point = fn(x K) Y {f(x)}(source_point)
                    fn(x K) Y {f(x)}(source_point) = f(source_point)
                    source_point $in family_union(fn_range(fn(index J) open_sets_X {pullback_cover(index)}))
                    obtain source_open from exist source_open fn_range(fn(index J) open_sets_X {pullback_cover(index)}) st {source_point $in source_open}
                    have by preimage selected_index from source_open $in fn_range(fn(index J) open_sets_X {pullback_cover(index)})
                    selected_index $in J
                    source_open = fn(index J) open_sets_X {pullback_cover(index)}(selected_index)
                    fn(index J) open_sets_X {pullback_cover(index)}(selected_index) = pullback_cover(selected_index)
                    source_point $in pullback_cover(selected_index)
                    pullback_cover(selected_index) = {x X: f(x) $in cover(selected_index)}
                    f(source_point) $in cover(selected_index)
                    fn(index J) open_sets_Y {cover(index)}(selected_index) $in fn_range(fn(index J) open_sets_Y {cover(index)})
                    fn(index J) open_sets_Y {cover(index)}(selected_index) = cover(selected_index)
                    cover(selected_index) $in fn_range(fn(index J) open_sets_Y {cover(index)})
                    image_point = f(source_point)
                    image_point $in cover(selected_index)
                    witness exist target_open fn_range(fn(index J) open_sets_Y {cover(index)}) st {image_point $in target_open} from cover(selected_index):
                        image_point $in cover(selected_index)
                    image_point $in family_union(fn_range(fn(index J) open_sets_Y {cover(index)}))
                by def:
                    ? image_of_K $subset family_union(fn_range(fn(index J) open_sets_Y {cover(index)}))
    by def $is_compact_subset(Y, open_sets_Y, fn_range(fn(x K) Y {f(x)}))
